correctness.rationale: All 4095 nonempty subsets of each graph are checked against two independently implemented face predicates. The explicit acyclic matchings pair 428 of 863 and 211 of 455 nonempty faces, leaving critical profiles (one 0, three 3, three 4) and (one 0, thirty-two 3). Exact signed integer gradient-path reduction gives a zero 3-by-3 Morse boundary; degree classification of pi_3 of a wedge of 3-spheres proves the mixed wedge, and absence of adjacent critical dimensions proves the other wedge. Full directed Hasse graph acyclicity and independent mod-two chain ranks replay successfully.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of the first higher-independence complexes for the only two Archimedean solid graphs on twelve vertices. Both are nonpure, yet one has a genuine two-degree integral wedge with ranks 3 and 3 and the other has 32 three-spheres. The exact integer attaching-map calculation, beyond Euler characteristics or field Betti numbers, supplies meaningful nonchordal polyhedral benchmarks and distinguishes structural possibilities at fixed graph order.
